[SWS_CRYPT_20906]
⌈
The X.509 Provider shall support the standard
protocol, OCSP (as defined in [30, RFC 6960]) and OCSP Stapling (as defined in [46,
RFC 6066], [47, RFC 6961], and [48, RFC 8446]), to check if a certificate is revoked.
OCSP is an alternative to CRLs.
⌋
